ministry: Department of Revenue & Disaster Management, Tamil Nadu

en.name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai
en.shortDescription: ₹1,000 per month for women heads of families in Tamil Nadu with family income up to ₹2.5 lakh.
en.benefits: ₹1,000 per month credited to the woman head of the family's bank account.
howToApplySteps: Apply at the special camps / ration shop area camps announced by the district administration.

hi.name: कलैग्नर मगलिर उरिमै तोगै
hi.shortDescription: ₹2.5 लाख तक पारिवारिक आय वाले तमिलनाडु के परिवारों की महिला मुखिया को ₹1,000 प्रति माह।
hi.benefits: परिवार की महिला मुखिया के बैंक खाते में हर महीने ₹1,000।
howToApplySteps: ज़िला प्रशासन द्वारा घोषित विशेष शिविरों में आवेदन करें।

all.note: Must be a resident of the state
No family member pays income tax
Up to 5 acres wet land (or 10 acres dry land)
